searchText: i can tell you with 100% honesty and truth (in my opinion), when pett and fox were in charge, i felt respected. i was looked at as a leader. they asked my opinion and respected what i had to say. i need in a million years felt unsafe or objected. it was the opposite. i felt safe in that environment. as soon as dave baldwin showed up, it became very clear to me that if you don’t have a penis, he didn’t give you the time of day. he had his “boys club” the young guys and if you were not apart of it, you were up shits creek without a paddle.  jessica ruddy
